ns2:course.label: Adv Steel Design
ns2:course.description: Advanced topics in the design of steel structures; critical study of the AISC specification; design of steel members and their connections; composite structures; and the analysis and design of continuous structures and tall buildings. Prerequisite: ARCH 560 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ARCH 560 or consent of instructor.
